description: Show the whiteboard beside the open coach, or close it (show false). It shows a title, an answer's text and a picture: image_url is an https picture on the web, which GoldSeam fetches for the view (the view may not load other sites' pictures; at most 1 MB). While it is shown, the coach view splits its space between the coach and the whiteboard. Use it when the person asks to see something (a campus, a chart, an answer written out) or asks for the whiteboard, and with an answer whose key points or picture help the person follow what the coach says; close it when they are done. Use the coach_id open_coach returned. The answer says what was queued; queued is not evidence the person saw it.

caption.description: Optional: where the picture is from; its site when omitted

image_url.description: Optional: an https address of a picture to show

show.description: true shows the whiteboard with what is given; false closes it

text.description: Optional: the answer or notes to show
